purpose: Text-free decorative artwork for an independent studio art study and website asset showcase.
status: New original generated artwork; not gameplay captures or proof of production integration. Fictional courtyard, not official campus imagery.
preparation: Generated PNG files copied byte-for-byte into the project; original files retained. Website compression derivatives are recorded separately in Website/media/provenance.json.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original square art-print texture for a framed canvas in BalloonBarrage, a cozy cream-and-teal artist studio game.
Primary request: a restrained abstract study connecting balloon shapes, brush gestures and musical rhythm, without notation or text.
Subject: three large rounded pear-shaped balloon forms, one muted coral, one deep teal, one warm mustard, with short loose charcoal strings; a few broad imperfect pigment swipes and tiny indigo dots form a gentle rising visual rhythm.
Style/medium: beautiful tactile contemporary screen print on warm ivory paper, subtle ink grain and slightly irregular handmade edges, sophisticated simple shapes.
Composition/framing: perfectly flat front-on square artwork, full bleed; shapes occupy the middle two thirds with generous quiet ivory margin, balanced asymmetric composition; easily readable from across a room.
Color palette: ivory #F4E6D0, coral #FF6B6B, teal #3EC6C0, mustard #FFD166, indigo #5B5F97, restrained charcoal #30343F.
Lighting/mood: evenly lit opaque printed artwork, warm, relaxing and playful.
Constraints: artwork only, no physical frame, room, perspective, shadows, branding, text, lettering, numerals, logos, UI, watermark, characters or recognizable existing game imagery; do not present a mockup or contact sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept.

Color palette: muted sage and deep teal foliage, a restrained coral accent, warm ochre pigment, cream #F4E6D0 ground and small charcoal marks.
Lighting/mood: evenly lit opaque printed artwork, restful late-afternoon studio mood.
Constraints: artwork only, no frame, furniture, room, perspective, cast shadows, gradients simulating lighting, labels, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, people or identifiable existing artwork; one composition, not a sheet of options.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original opaque portrait 3:4 window-view texture for BalloonBarrage's warm artist studio, also suitable for a website art-library preview.
Primary request: a peaceful fictional early-autumn courtyard visible from indoors, showing only the outdoor view without any window or interior.
Scene/backdrop: a pale apricot sky, simple distant cream workshop buildings with muted teal roofs, a quiet pale-stone path curving past terracotta planters, small maple-like trees with restrained ochre and sage foliage, a distant shaded archway.
Style/medium: polished painterly stylized game environment illustration, broad readable shapes, subtle brush texture, soft depth and low visual noise.
Composition/framing: portrait 3:4 full-bleed outdoor landscape; upper third quiet pale sky, foliage framing the sides, architecture in the middle distance and path in foreground; composed for a tall studio window panel.
Lighting/mood: gentle late-afternoon daylight, restful, welcoming, low contrast without a bright sun disc.
Color palette: warm ivory #F4E6D0, honey oak, muted teal, sage green, soft ochre, restrained coral terracotta.
Constraints: wholly fictional place, no recognizable real campus or landmarks; no window frame, glass, interior, balloons, gun, people, animals, vehicles, signs, lettering, text, logos, watermark or UI; no collage or concept labels.
